changelog: Initial release of backlog lifecycle skill
summary: Unified backlog lifecycle management and task tracking. Orchestrates session TODOs, workspace checklists (`fix_plan.md`, `checklist.md`), and issue trackers with vendor-agnostic lifecycle contracts. Topics — triage (classify incoming requests into session/file/issue backlogs), priority (GitHub-aligned P0-P3 urgency tagging and blocker triage), sync (external tracker status polling and resolution), prune (demote lower-priority backlog noise from active focus), and lifecycle (authoring, state transitions, DoD criteria). Use when: "backlog", "backlog triage", "backlog sync", "backlog prune", "task lifecycle", "manage backlog", "backlog priority", "backlog cleanup".
